Method of Attack: Arbitrary code execution through deserialization of malicious Avro schemas in Parquet files
Discoverer: Andrew Pikler, David Handermann, and Nándor Kollár
Impacted Systems: Apache Hadoop, Spark, Flink, and other data analytics infrastructures using Apache Parquet Java
Attack Vector: Supplying crafted Parquet files with malicious Avro schemas to applications using the parquet-avro module
